fields.name: address
fields.description: The per-user inbound email address (lowercase local part + inbound domain). The mail-server resolves an arriving message's To against this column to find the owner. Uniqueness is enforced by the app's query-then-create registration, not by a gateway constraint.

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Lattice uid of the address owner. The receiver copies this into MailMessage.userId so the mail lands in the right inbox.

fields.name: userName
fields.description: Display name of the owner at registration time — operational debugging aid for the mailbox registry.
